source: TrustLensAI_Scientific_Logs_Layers_Formulas.xlsx — sheet 'Scientific RMTE (Master)' plus 'Logs ↔ Formula Inputs' and 'Logs ↔ Architecture Layers'
notes: Each Scientific pipeline stage emits telemetry; TrustLensAI platform layers ingest and evaluate it. TrustLensAI produces evidence; it does not certify compliance.

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.ingested_by: L1 · Instrumentation & Telemetry → L3 · Evaluation & Assurance

layers.notes: Sensitive biomedical data redacted at capture (in-perimeter)

layers.key_fields: reconstructed pipeline traces, dependency views, time-series
layers.ingested_by: Consumes canonical events (D1-gated / target)

layers.key_fields: evaluator outputs, accuracy/plausibility/UQ/generalization/consistency scores
layers.ingested_by: Consumes prediction/validity/validation logs + experimental & benchmark refs

layers.key_fields: metric defs, thresholds, mappings, experimental refs & controlled-agent lists, versions
layers.ingested_by: Supplies formulas/thresholds & reference data to L3
layers.notes: Governs the Science RMTE metric corpus (net-new)

layers.key_fields: dual-use, biosecurity, access-control, privacy, contamination decisions, gates
layers.ingested_by: Consumes evaluation evidence; runs release gates

layers.key_fields: Evidence Pack manifest, RFC 6962 inclusion proofs / hashes, Trust Score (Q6)
